text2activity_extraction_model.title: NGHE autonomous construction ground truth (relation closure) scenario

source_units.planned_content: The ICCC sets the goals of at least 38,000 m3 within 72 h and zero personnel accidents, and after confirming the infrastructure, RTDD, and HSM, completes the DMSS/ASPCS terrain model and the calibration of 19 units of equipment and starts in Level 3.

After 2 h of stable operation, it transitions to Level 4 and performs excavation, hauling, grading, and compaction, and the remote operator controls the equipment fleet without direct operation. It maintains the battery replacement of U-EEX Unit 1, preventive maintenance following the PHM module's detection of the hydraulic anomaly sign of U-EDT Unit 7, OTA application, and night operation at 65 dB or less.

Around 48 h, fog degrades visibility and sensor confidence, so operation is restricted to Level 3, 5 km/h or less, and 2 times the safety distance, and following the forged packet detection by U-EEX Unit 3, the security system switches to the internal closed network and leaves a log.

After U-EEX Unit 2 performs a local stop due to contamination and pedestrian approach, all equipment transitions to Level 1 due to 30 mm heavy rain, and after the heavy rain ends, through rescanning, bypassing of 2 subsidence zones, and recovery to Level 3 and to Level 4 after 30 min, a comprehensive report of 38,200 m3 and zero accidents is generated at 72 h.

scenarios.label: NGHE 72 h autonomous construction and contingency response
scenarios.summary: The unmanned equipment fleet performs autonomous construction for 72 h and, through fog, cyber threat, and heavy rain situations, achieves the target earthwork volume.
